position_rules: BIP39 word encoding/checksum recovers16/20/24/28/32 entropy bytes. PBKDF2 uses those bytes, not the mnemonic sentence.

external_secret.guidance: Any supported recovery passphrase and derivation path stay outside Tessaveil. Local encryption/unlock passwords are distinct.

semantic_distinction: Polkadot/Kusama source family; primitive evidence is not wallet/path/address compatibility. sr25519, ed25519, ecdsa, Ethereum and hardware modes must not be conflated. Raw primitive does not normalize password; consumer behavior varies.
